title: Round-robin arbiter
spec: A round-robin arbiter for N requesters with one rising-edge clock clk. req is an N-bit vector of request lines; grant is an N-bit registered output.

rst is a synchronous active-high reset: at a rising edge with rst high, grant becomes all zeros and the arbiter forgets any previous grants, so requester 0 has the highest priority for the next grant.

At each rising edge without reset: if no request line is high, grant becomes all zeros. Otherwise grant becomes one-hot, selecting exactly one requester whose req bit is high at that edge. The choice is round robin: starting from the requester just after the most recently granted one (wrapping from N-1 to 0), the first requester with its req bit high is granted. A requester that keeps requesting is therefore granted within N edges that have any request.
grant only changes at rising edges and depends only on req, rst, and the arbiter's own history.
